verdict.rationale: Looking up the status of a filing, application, or case is a fair question for a state corporation commission, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing that crawling was disallowed and never performed. None of it documents a public status-lookup capability, so the verdict is none rather than na.
